items.comparator: For the reaction, earlier selectivity was 51.82%; the article says the improvement occurred over three months. No comparator or methodology is stated for the specialty-chemical yield claim.
items.quantitative_outcome: The company-reported article states that Mira raised a single-step reaction's selectivity from 51.82% to 85% in three months. It also reports that, in a separate specialty-chemicals project, production yield improved from 72% to nearly 90%.
items.signal: AI-driven autonomous chemistry experiments with reported improvements in reaction selectivity and specialty-chemical production yield; the article does not identify the client or provide independent verification.
items.source: ACCESS Newswire article republished by Yahoo Finance

items.comparator: The company/TNO comparison is the typical design-and-selection phase taking years; no controlled baseline or measurement method is described.
items.quantitative_outcome: TNO says the design and selection phase for a new polymer is reduced to weeks rather than years. The article also reports a proprietary polymer-property database built over four years and a lab capacity of 25 materials per week.
items.signal: A potentially hard-to-copy combination of a manually source-verified proprietary polymer-property database and in-house synthesis/testing; the time reduction is attributed to TNO, without a described independent evaluation.
items.source: IndustryLinqs reporting on TNO's transfer of its polymer-design program to polySCOUT

items.comparator: Reference yields obtained using conventional calibration curves.
items.quantitative_outcome: XtalPi reports a mean absolute yield error of 4.74% across 178 reactions spanning four common reaction types, compared with reference yields from conventional calibration curves.
items.signal: AI model for estimating chemical reaction yields without a pure reference standard for each target compound. The reported benchmark is quantitative, but the article is a company release and does not describe an independent evaluation.

items.quantitative_outcome: None stated. The companies announced plans to create Cascade, a dataset comprising 100 million single-cell RNA-seq profiles and more than 11,000 proteomic secretome profiles across over 150,000 perturbation conditions; the release calls it the largest AI-ready resource of its kind for immune modeling.
items.signal: Planned joint creation of a large multimodal immune-biology dataset, with foundational partner commitments from GSK, Pfizer, Sanofi, Graph Therapeutics, and Turbine. This is a distinctive data-access move, not a measured operating benefit.
items.source: Company announcement carried by Business Wire

items.quantitative_outcome: None stated. The report describes a multi-year collaboration integrating PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing with Verily’s governed data and AI platform to create AI-ready clinico-genomic datasets; it gives no measured outcome.
items.signal: Partnership combines long-read genomic data with real-world clinical data at population scale, a potentially distinctive data-access position for biomedical discovery and AI model development. No quantified benefit is reported.

items.comparator: In one reported manufacturing-record review, about 26 hours of manual work versus under three hours including human confirmation; source reports an 89% time reduction. Other reported project outcomes use different tasks and comparators.
items.quantitative_outcome: A secondary report says the work included a roughly 70% reduction in CAR-T signaling-domain sequence length, more than 10-fold improvement in antibody binding affinity, and an 89% reduction in manufacturing-record review time. The review-time comparison was about 26 hours manually versus under three hours with AI plus human confirmation. The article cautions these were task-specific results and do not establish shorter overall drug-development timelines.
items.signal: Reported AI-assisted results across several drug-development tasks may indicate workflow and discovery benefits, but they are heterogeneous and the source is secondary; treat as a weak candidate pending verification against the original research article.
items.source: Xenospectrum, summarizing Anthropic research and collaborations

items.comparator: Year-over-year: P&C claims savings from smart fraud detection were up 9.7%; no before/after workflow baseline stated for the other figures.
items.quantitative_outcome: The company reported that AI service representatives handled about 1,484 million customer-service interactions in the first nine months of 2026, or 82% of total service volume. It also reported RMB10.04bn in P&C claims savings from smart fraud detection, up 9.7% year over year, and said 95% of life policies were underwritten within seconds.
items.signal: Large-scale AI service handling plus reported fraud-detection savings and rapid underwriting are operating-benefit signals; the disclosure does not establish a defensible competitive advantage or explain how the measures were counted.
items.source: Ping An’s unaudited nine-month 2026 results, as described in the linked report.

items.comparator: Google compared Gemini 4 Carbon with GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Fable 5.1 on the cited benchmarks; for internal secure-code and patching results, the comparator was Argon or an unnamed rival model. These are benchmark comparisons, not measured customer operating benefits.
items.quantitative_outcome: Google reported 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8% on ExploitGym, and 71.0% on Collinear’s CWE-bench. It also said Carbon was “more than twice as successful as Argon at writing secure code” on internal benchmarks, and that its Chrome team found Carbon “outperformed a large frontier model from a rival lab by more than 10 times” at generating high-quality patches.
items.signal: Cybersecurity-focused model benchmark results and limited early access for cyber defenders through Google’s Fairwind Program. Weak competitive-advantage signal: the results are company-reported benchmark scores, not demonstrated operational gains, and access is limited.

Orange Cyberdefense said it had integrated Qevlar AI into its SOCs in France and internationally, alongside an agent-based layer and a “proprietary, autonomous threat knowledge base.” This is a potential distinctive data-access / accumulated-threat-knowledge signal, but the article gives no quantitative operating outcome or comparison.

Orange Cyberdefense said its partnership with Mistral AI makes it the first European MSSP in Mistral’s Design Partner program and gives it early access to a cybersecurity-optimized variant of Mistral Large 4. The planned focus is penetration testing, technical audits, investigation, and incident response. This is an access and partnership signal; no measured benefit is reported.

items.comparator: Against the prior engineering effort and time-to-market for preparing new PCB assemblies; the release does not provide a separate baseline or methodology for the maximum figures.
items.quantitative_outcome: Siemens said virtual production preparation can reduce engineering effort by up to 85 percent and cut time-to-market by up to 40 percent. It also said AI-supported agent-based production planning can enable cost savings of up to 20 percent.
items.signal: At Siemens’ Electronics Factory in Erlangen, AI and digital twins support virtual production preparation and production planning. These are quantified workflow and cost benefits at a named operating facility, though the figures are company-reported and phrased as potential maximums.

items.comparator: Compared with the refinery’s operating baseline; the source does not detail the baseline or measurement method. It says the estimate depends on refinery configuration, operating conditions, and other factors.
items.quantitative_outcome: Honeywell said preliminary data indicate the platform could deliver an operational benefit of more than 29 cents a barrel at the Lekki Refinery, or more than $60 million in gross benefit per year at full-capacity throughput. Honeywell notes this excludes implementation costs and is an estimate, not a stated realized result.
items.signal: Forge Plant Cognition is launching first at Dangote’s Lekki refinery, with AI-enabled optimization targeting throughput, yield, and product value. A facility-specific estimate is a candidate operating-benefit signal, but it remains preliminary and vendor-reported.

items.comparator: The source identifies a field trial using 5G spectrum but gives no numerical comparator or measured improvement.
items.signal: Elisa reported completing what it called Europe’s first over-the-air field trial in which voice, mobile data, and video analytics ran simultaneously on an AI-RAN platform. This is a distinctive deployment milestone, but the source reports no measured operating benefit, so it is only a weak signal rather than evidence of competitive advantage.
